goal.answer: Complete HealthCapsule Module 1 (Doctor Directory) from the current project state: apply the Schedule schema migration, verify the seed script, build the public doctor search/profile pages, implement the doctor self-edit portal, and implement the admin verification/tier-management portal.

payload.plain: Complete HealthCapsule Module 1 (Doctor Directory) from the current project state: apply the Schedule schema migration, verify the seed script, build the public doctor search/profile pages, implement the doctor self-edit portal, and implement the admin verification/tier-management portal.

criteria.answer:
Phase 3 complete: Prisma migration for the Schedule model is applied to the Neon database, `npx prisma db seed` runs without errors, and verified/pending sample doctors with chambers and schedules exist.
Phase 4 public directory: `/doctors` supports filtering by specialty, area, and name; only `VERIFIED` doctors are visible; featured/new-doctor badges render correctly.
Phase 4 profile pages: `/doctors/[slug]` renders BMDC badge, degrees, experience, fee, chambers, and next-available schedule; unknown slugs show a custom 404.
Phase 5 doctor portal: `/portal/doctor` lets an authenticated DOCTOR edit bio, photo, fee, degrees, languages, and chambers; changes reflect immediately on the public profile.
Phase 6 admin portal: `/portal/admin` shows a doctor verification queue and allows toggling verification status and listing tier.
Global quality gates: `npx prisma validate`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, and `npx prisma db seed` all succeed without errors.

phases.answer: Phase 3: Schema Migration & Seed Verification, Phase 4: Public Doctor Directory Pages & API, Phase 5: Doctor Self-Edit Portal, Phase 6: Admin Verification & Tier Management, Phase 7: Global QA & Final Verification

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 3: Schema Migration & Seed Verification
phaseSnapshots.goal: Apply the Schedule model migration to Neon and verify the seed script populates geography, specialties, and sample doctors.
phaseSnapshots.description: Create and apply the Prisma migration that adds the Schedule table, then run `npx prisma db seed` against the Neon database and fix any seed-time errors.

steps.description: Generate and apply the Prisma migration for the Schedule model and Chamber relation.
Run the seed script and ensure it populates divisions, districts, thanas, areas, specialties, admin user, doctor users, doctors, chambers, and schedules.

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 4: Public Doctor Directory Pages & API
phaseSnapshots.goal: Build the public-facing doctor search and profile pages.
phaseSnapshots.description: Create server components and API routes for listing/searching verified doctors and rendering individual doctor profiles with chambers and next-available schedules.

steps.description: Create the doctor search page at `/doctors` with specialty/area/name filters and server-side data fetching.

verification.command: npm run build succeeds and `/doctors` HTML contains verified doctor names.

steps.description: Create the doctor profile page at `/doctors/[slug]` with BMDC, degrees, experience, fee, chambers, and next-available schedule; unknown slugs return 404.

verification.command: npm run build succeeds; fetch `/doctors/dr-sarah-rahman` returns 200 with expected content.

steps.description: Implement next-available schedule calculation from Chamber.schedules and display it on profile cards/pages.

verification.command: Unit-like check: function returns a future date string for a chamber with a schedule matching a future weekday.

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 5: Doctor Self-Edit Portal
phaseSnapshots.goal: Allow an authenticated DOCTOR to edit their own public profile and chambers.
phaseSnapshots.description: Build `/portal/doctor` with forms/server actions for bio, photo, fee, degrees, languages, and chambers; edits reflect on public profile.

steps.description: Create the doctor portal dashboard layout and profile edit form with server actions.

verification.command: npm run build succeeds; page is accessible for DOCTOR role (middleware allows).

steps.description: Implement chamber and schedule management (add/edit/remove chambers and weekly schedules).

verification.command: After edit, public profile `/doctors/[slug]` shows updated chamber/schedule data.

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 6: Admin Verification & Tier Management
phaseSnapshots.goal: Allow authenticated ADMIN to review and manage doctor verification status and listing tier.
phaseSnapshots.description: Build `/portal/admin` with a doctor queue table, verification status toggles, and tier selection.

steps.description: Create admin portal page with a queue of doctors filtered by verification status.

verification.command: npm run build succeeds; page is accessible for ADMIN role.

steps.description: Implement server actions to update verification status and listing tier.

verification.command: After admin action, public doctor listing and profile reflect the new status/tier.

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 7: Global QA & Final Verification
phaseSnapshots.goal: Run all project-level quality gates and commit the final state.
phaseSnapshots.description: Execute the validation commands required by the success criteria and create a final commit.

steps.description: Run Prisma validate, TypeScript check, lint, build, and seed.

verification.command: node.exe ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js validate && node.exe ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build && node.exe ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db seed

steps.description: Commit all remaining changes with the existing WSL git identity.

verification.command: git log --oneline -1 shows the final commit on master.

assumptions.answer: The previous Ferment's committed work (Phase 1 Foundation and Phase 2 Auth) is the starting baseline.; The user wants all remaining Module 1 phases completed (Phase 3 migration/seed through Phase 6 admin portal).; Sample doctor accounts seeded in `prisma/seed.ts` are acceptable for local QA: admin `01800000000` / `password123`, doctors `01711111111`, `01722222222`, `01733333333` / `password123`.; Existing Prisma schema and seed data in `prisma/seed.ts` are mostly correct and only need migration + runtime fixes.; Public pages will use server components + server actions for data fetching/mutations, consistent with the existing App Router setup.
